build_standard_arena: build a Standard arena with skybox texture, checker ground plane, lighting, and fixed cameras for board game simulations
attach_entity_with_offset: attach an entity to the Standard arena at a specified XYZ offset from the attachment site
observe_top_down_camera: observe the top_down_camera observable to get a bird's eye view of the board game arena
observe_top_down_invisible_robot: observe the top_down_camera_invisible_robot observable to view the arena with robot geometries hidden
access_front_cameras: access the front_camera and front_camera_2 properties to get MJCF camera elements for board game viewing
